title: Integrate differential-drive odometry
scope: Exact constant-wheel arc on a planar model

items.prompt: Robot starts at (0,0), heading 0. Left/right wheel LINEAR speeds are 0.1,0.2 m/s; track width b=0.5 m. Integrate their constant speeds exactly for 1 s. Return x,y,heading. No slip assumed.
items.solution: v=(vl+vr)/2=0.15; ω=(vr−vl)/b=0.2. x=v sin(ωt)/ω, y=v(1−cos(ωt))/ω. This is odometry, not localization.
hints: Identify the requested quantity and its units before calculating.
Write the equation using the supplied inputs, then check units and signs.

items.remediation: Compare one intermediate result with the stated model. Revisit /lessons/R02 or try the other scenario. This is a suggestion, not a diagnosis.
